color.description: HTML color code of the user's highest priority rank

badges.description: List of badges for the user's currecntly active ranks

total_kills.description: Total number of kills by the user

total_deaths.description: Total number of deaths of the user

total_pvp_deaths.description: Total number of PvP deaths of the user (excluding deaths from non-player causes)

credits.description: Total number of credits the user has

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the user created their account

last_online.description: Timestamp of when the user was last online. For older users, this is their creation date

objective_data.description: Mapping of objective names to counts completed

friends.description: List of usernames of the user's friends

punishments_received.description: Total number of punishments received by the user

punishments_issued.description: Total number of punishments issued by the user

teams.description: List of teams the user is a member of
